_comment_insecure: iLO ships a self-signed certificate. Set to false once you have installed a trusted one.
_comment_interval: Seconds between polls. iLO 4 takes 1-3s per Redfish call; below 10 the poller clamps.
_comment_storage: Smart Array monitoring. The walk costs one request per physical drive, so it runs on its own slower cycle; set storage to false to skip it entirely.
_comment_smart: Fill drive temperature and run time from smartctl when iLO leaves them empty, which is what happens with third-party disks in HP carriers. Runs on the storage cycle.
_comment_ids: Chassis and system ids. '1' is correct for every single-node ProLiant.
